title: UneceCountry
description:
The area of land that belongs to a nation together with its properties, such as population, political organization,
etc., used or referenced for trade purposes.

countryId.description: A unique identifier for this trade country.

name.description: A name, expressed as text, of this trade country.

specifiedQuantity.description: A quantity specified for this trade country.

subordinateCountrySubDivision.description: A trade country sub-division that is subordinate to this trade country, such as a state, a county, a canton, a province.
